test_cases.name: complete_generation
test_cases.input: Create a calm, precise interface system for an operations dashboard used by analysts.
assertions: Uses semantic rather than raw-color token names
Renders and inspects the responsive specimen

test_cases.name: brand_preservation
test_cases.input: Evolve this existing system for compact dashboards but preserve the supplied primary color and typography.
assertions: Treats supplied brand values as constraints
Does not describe inferred values as official brand rules

test_cases.name: bounded_decision_adapter
test_cases.input: Use Laya to choose between precision, editorial, warm, and civic directions.
assertions: Uses one bounded decision per candidate label
Records provider, selection, confidence, and fallback
Does not allow provider output to override contrast or supplied brand constraints

test_cases.name: scope_boundary
test_cases.input: Create a logo and corporate identity program.
assertions: Does not claim this skill creates logos or a corporate identity program
Routes image or brand asset work to an appropriate tool when available
